title: Computer Vision Engineer
description:
Home Credit Bank Kazakhstan is looking for a Computer Vision Engineer to work on document processing, KYC automation, and biometric verification systems. You will build CV pipelines that process millions of customer documents and selfies.

Responsibilities:
— Develop document detection and classification models (passports, ID cards, certificates)
— Build OCR pipelines for printed and handwritten text
— Work on face detection, face matching, and liveness detection systems
— Implement image quality checks and anti-spoofing measures
— Train models on internal datasets using PyTorch
— Optimize inference performance for production (quantization, ONNX, TensorRT)
— Collaborate with backend engineers on serving infrastructure
— Stay current with state-of-the-art CV research

Requirements:
— 2+ years in Computer Vision / Deep Learning roles
— Strong Python and PyTorch (or TensorFlow) skills
— Experience with OpenCV, image processing fundamentals
— Understanding of CNN architectures (ResNet, EfficientNet, Vision Transformers)
— Hands-on experience training and evaluating CV models
— Familiarity with detection / segmentation models (YOLO, Detectron2)
— Git, Docker, Linux

Nice to have: experience with OCR models (TrOCR, PaddleOCR), face recognition systems, edge deployment, knowledge of biometric standards (ISO/IEC 19794), experience in fintech / KYC.
